classification.difficultyReason: Both parts directly apply the taught frequency-recovery rule to supplied cumulative totals: retain the first total and subtract adjacent totals. The scaffold identifies every score and requires no additional inference.

content.prompt: Determine the frequency from the cumulative frequency.

answer.short:
Frequency: $4,\ 2,\ 4,\ 5,\ 3$.

Keep the first cumulative total; subtract consecutive cumulative totals for the remaining frequencies.
answer.worked:
The first frequency equals the first cumulative total. Subtract the preceding cumulative total for each later score.
$$\begin{align*}f_3&=4\\f_4&=6-4=2\\f_5&=10-6=4\\f_6&=15-10=5\\f_7&=18-15=3\end{align*}$$

The first frequency equals the first cumulative total. Subtract the preceding cumulative total for each later score.
$$\begin{align*}f_{12}&=5\\f_{13}&=11-5=6\\f_{14}&=19-11=8\\f_{15}&=29-19=10\\f_{16}&=34-29=5\\f_{17}&=36-34=2\end{align*}$$
